Do not aggregate normalized, integrated, scaled, imputed, corrected, or residual values as counts.
Do not use cells, clusters, technical libraries, or duplicated pseudobulks as independent biological replicates.
Do not fit or interpret rank-deficient, confounded, under-replicated, direction-ambiguous, or failed-diagnostic contrasts.
Do not remove samples solely to improve significance, select filters after seeing differential results, or report nominal p-values as multiplicity-controlled evidence.
Do not present generated scripts, successful process exits, unexecuted alternative engines, or unreloaded files as scientific evidence.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Aggregate by the true biological sample and the most specific reviewed cell-type level supported across samples; merge technical libraries only when their biological identity and count semantics are identical.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require one condition and covariate profile per biological sample, exact cell and count conservation, and no duplicate biological sample within a tested cell type.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Set cell-count and library-size thresholds from observed distributions and model stability before testing, retaining reason-coded excluded groups in the manifest.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Compare retention by condition and cell type and block contrasts whose exclusions create structural imbalance or inadequate biological replication.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Include terms justified by the experimental design and estimand; explicitly classify categorical and continuous covariates; encode subject for paired or repeated data only when condition remains estimable; and avoid adjustment for mediators or perfectly confounded variables.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require finite numeric continuous covariates, reviewed factor levels, a full-rank matrix, one explicit coefficient with verified direction, sufficient residual degrees of freedom, and a documented confounding table for every tested cell type.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose a validated engine whose model and robust options fit the observed data; use an independently validated alternative for consequential method-sensitive claims.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Verify engine-native filtering, normalization, dispersion or precision weights, coefficient identity, result fields, p-value bounds, and concordance of effect direction across sensitivity runs.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare an engine-appropriate pre-test expression rule from eligible biological samples without conditioning on observed differential significance.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Report retained genes and sensitivity near the threshold; preserve the tested gene universe for multiplicity and enrichment background.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Record BH adjustment within each tested cell type and across the combined tested family; use the scope matching the stated inferential claim.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Recompute adjusted values independently, verify monotonic bounds and tested-family size, and do not promote nominal p-values as discoveries.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Investigate flagged samples using technical and biological metadata; retain the primary analysis and add justified sensitivity analyses without deleting samples solely to improve significance.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Classify findings as stable, attenuated, reversed, or unresolved and update the hypothesis ledger accordingly.

postflight_checks: Reconcile every input cell and raw count with exactly one sample-by-cell-type pseudobulk and reason-code every ineligible aggregate.
Reload pseudobulk counts and metadata, verify ordered identifiers, integer counts, count conservation, sample uniqueness, condition consistency, and digest agreement.

For every completed cell type, verify biological replicate counts, design formula, full rank, condition coefficient direction, residual information, filtering, normalization, model fit, effect fields, p-value bounds, BH correction, and actual tool versions.
Inspect sample-level PCA or MDS, library sizes, condition and batch structure, influential observations, p-value and effect distributions, cell-type missingness, and skipped analyses.
Run and compare declared sensitivity analyses for consequential findings; record stable, weakened, reversed, underpowered, and non-estimable outcomes without significance-driven sample removal.
Reload result and diagnostic artifacts and require all fatal gates to pass before enrichment, figures, writing, or hypothesis-ledger admission.
preflight_checks: Inspect the actual h5ad, raw-count layer, annotation provenance, feature namespace, cell accounting, and design metadata before code generation.

Detect actual Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, R, edgeR, DESeq2, limma, jsonlite, and digest versions; use only declared compatible combinations or stop for an explicit compatibility experiment.
Explicitly classify every adjusted variable as categorical or continuous, verify factor levels and finite numeric values, and reject overlap or undeclared coercion.

Verify biological sample, cell type, condition, subject, covariate, batch, and technical-library cross-tabs; identify nesting, pairing, missingness, confounding, and available residual degrees of freedom.

Confirm the reference and contrast levels, experimental estimand, planned tested family, aggregation thresholds, filtering rule, primary engine, sensitivity engines, and output paths before execution.
Confirm outputs are new project-owned files and that neither source objects nor raw counts will be modified.

version_differences.required_action: Inspect the detected Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, and SciPy combination and rerun count-conservation and output-reload tests before support.
Use DGEList, filterByExpr, TMM normalization, robust estimateDisp and glmQLFit, and independently validate coefficient identity and output fields.

input.design_notes: Four donors per condition; library is nested within donor.
input.objective: Establish a quality-controlled single-cell RNA-seq object for donor-aware analysis.

code_plan.purpose: Generate a read-only inspection stage that establishes object format and scientific semantics before transformation.
required_logic: Read only the declared format with its format-native API and report object, matrix, layer, assay, feature, observation, and metadata structure.
Reject duplicate or empty cell and feature identifiers, nonfinite values, ambiguous matrix orientation, missing biological sample identity, and undeclared modalities.
Locate raw counts by evidence from value distribution and object metadata; never infer raw counts from a conventional layer name alone.

code_plan.purpose: Generate assay-aware per-cell, per-sample, and per-feature QC with explicit accounting and optional contamination diagnostics.
required_logic: Calculate counts, detected features, mitochondrial and ribosomal fractions, complexity, and sample-stratified distributions before filtering.
Separate empty-droplet, ambient-RNA, and doublet evidence; execute only methods available in a separately validated environment and preserve method-specific scores.
Assign every cell one retained or reason-coded excluded state and compare retention across biological samples and batches.

code_plan.purpose: Generate backend-appropriate normalization, highly variable feature selection, and scaling while preserving immutable raw counts.
required_logic: Copy raw counts to a declared immutable layer or assay before any transformation.
Choose normalization and HVG strategy from assay type, depth, model assumptions, batch design, and downstream tools rather than a universal default.
Regress covariates only when scientifically justified and record each regressed variable; do not regress away the biological contrast.

code_plan.purpose: Generate deterministic PCA, neighborhood, embedding, and graph-clustering code with explicit sensitivity parameters.
required_logic: Select principal components from variance structure, technical association, and sensitivity analysis rather than one fixed count.
Construct the neighbor graph on the declared representation and generate UMAP or t-SNE only as visualization embeddings.
Run Leiden or Louvain across a declared resolution grid with fixed random seeds and preserve every tested cluster assignment.

code_plan.purpose: Generate independent structural and scientific validation code before artifacts enter the research state.
required_logic: Reload every output object and verify raw counts, identifiers, metadata, reductions, graph, embeddings, cluster labels, and parameter records.
Quantify cluster stability, minimum cluster size, sample and batch composition, technical covariate association, and sensitivity to resolution or neighbor choices.
Write machine-readable QC and cluster-model reports and block biological labels when major or fatal gates remain.

forbidden_actions: Use only already available, project-approved scientific runtimes; do not change the user's execution environment from this module.
Do not silently convert formats, transpose matrices, guess raw-count layers, merge feature namespaces, rename cells, or join Seurat layers with different sample semantics.
Do not overwrite source artifacts or raw counts.
Do not use cells as independent biological replicates for condition-level inference.
Do not hard-code universal QC, PCA, neighbor, or clustering parameters without project evidence and sensitivity checks.
Do not report an unexecuted method, a generated script, a UMAP separation, or a cluster assignment as validated biological evidence.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Derive thresholds per biological sample when distributions or chemistry differ, document the rationale, and preserve a sensitivity comparison around each consequential threshold.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require complete cell accounting and flag sample-specific retention shifts that could alter the biological comparison.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose log normalization, variance-stabilizing transformation, or model-native raw-count handling only when its assumptions match the downstream analysis.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Verify that transformed values and raw counts occupy distinct declared locations and that library-size effects are reduced without erasing the intended contrast.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Select a version-supported HVG method and batch-aware option when batches are being jointly modeled; retain the complete feature universe for later reporting.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Report HVG count and overlap across samples or batches and block when one batch dominates selected features.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose a bounded principal-component range from observed structure and test neighboring values rather than using a universal fixed number.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Require stable broad neighborhoods and document PCs strongly associated with technical variables.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose and compare a biologically defensible neighborhood range scaled to retained observations and the target granularity.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Report neighborhood connectivity, isolated cells, and cluster sensitivity across the tested range.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Select a resolution only after comparing the full declared grid; do not optimize solely for visual separation or expected labels.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Block interpretation of clusters that are unstable, sample-exclusive without biological justification, too small for inference, or driven by technical covariates.

postflight_checks: Reload outputs with the same detected backend and prove structural validity rather than trusting a successful process exit.
Reconcile input, retained, and reason-coded excluded cell counts globally and by biological sample and batch.
Verify raw counts are byte- or value-equivalent at retained indices and were not overwritten by normalization, scaling, or integration.
Check finite transformed matrices, HVG accounting, PCA variance, graph connectivity, embedding completeness, cluster size, resolution stability, sample composition, and technical associations.
Record methods that were not run; never translate missing empty-droplet, ambient-RNA, or doublet evidence into a negative finding.
Require an explicit gate decision before cluster labels or downstream biological claims are admitted to the evidence ledger.
preflight_checks: Inspect the actual artifact before code generation and verify it matches the declared h5ad, 10x HDF5, Matrix Market, or Seurat v5 format contract.
Detect actual Scanpy or Seurat and dependency versions in the user scientific environment; select only a declared compatible profile or stop for a compatibility experiment.

Verify raw count location, integer-like nonnegative values, matrix orientation, unique identifiers, species, assay type, feature namespace, annotation release, sample manifest, biological sample key, batch keys, and modality set.
Assess whether sample, condition, batch, chemistry, donor, sex, age, tissue, and other design fields are complete and confounded before constructing a joint object.
Confirm requested writes are scoped to the user project and do not modify the source artifact.

version_differences.required_action: Inspect the detected Scanpy, anndata, igraph, leidenalg, umap-learn, and scikit-learn APIs and generate calls only for the observed compatible combination.
Inspect assay layers and generate Seurat v5 layer-aware code without silently coercing or joining biologically distinct samples.

input.design_notes: Independent samples span two batches; every reviewed class occurs in both; unknown cells remain unpromoted.
input.objective: Train and validate a count-aware scANVI model while retaining reviewed labels and unknown cells.

code_plan.purpose: Establish count, sample, batch, label, unknown, and model-use semantics before training.
required_logic: Inspect the real h5ad and sample manifest; validate immutable integer-like counts and unique identifiers.
Cross-tabulate samples, batches, reviewed labels, conditions, and unknown cells; block confounding or batch-confined classes.
Declare whether scVI latent modeling or scANVI semi-supervision answers the project question and keep no-model as an eligible decision.

code_plan.purpose: Train a project-specific model from raw counts in the detected existing runtime.
required_logic: Register the declared raw-count layer and batch key without altering the source object.
Freeze model architecture, likelihood, train split, epochs, seed, neighborhood metrics, and output paths before execution.
Train scVI unsupervised; for scANVI derive semi-supervised models from the same scVI foundation and never overwrite reviewed labels.

code_plan.purpose: Test the latent space and scANVI labels on independent gates.
required_logic: Compare batch entropy, known-label purity, and label connectivity with a frozen unintegrated PCA baseline.
For scANVI hide a stratified subset of every reviewed class during training and compute macro-F1 and balanced accuracy on held-out cells.
Store predictions, confidence, and review flags separately while retaining every original reviewed and unknown label.

code_plan.purpose: Bind scientific claims to reloadable model and h5ad artifacts.
required_logic: Save model state and registry plus an h5ad containing latent representation, graph, UMAP, suggestions, and unchanged counts and labels.
Reload model and h5ad independently and verify shapes, finite latent values, raw counts, labels, graph keys, parameters, versions, digests, and quality state.
Admit only observed artifacts passing every declared gate; preserve blocked runs and reasons.

code_plan.purpose: Generate an optional model-based contrast only after generative model admission.
required_logic: Require a declared group key and group values present in model metadata; use an empty second group only for one-versus-all, never the literal rest category.
Call differential_expression in change mode with a predeclared delta and verify proba_de, lfc_mean, bayes_factor, group1, and group2 before export.
Label output as exploratory cell-level evidence, preserve the full model result in project outputs, and route condition conclusions to donor-aware pseudobulk or mixed-model inference.

forbidden_actions: Use only already available, project-approved scientific runtimes; do not change the user's execution environment from this module.
Do not train on normalized values when the declared model requires raw counts.
Do not repair confounding with a latent model or tune against desired UMAP, labels, markers, conditions, or conclusions.
Do not evaluate scANVI only on labels used for training.
Do not overwrite raw counts, source objects, reviewed labels, unknown labels, cell identities, or sample provenance.
Do not treat normalized expression or a latent representation as count-level evidence for differential expression.
Do not report a generated script, trained but unreloaded model, or blocked artifact as validated evidence.
Do not treat Bayesian model-based cell-level differential expression as pseudobulk, donor-aware, population-level, causal, or condition-level inference.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use scVI for unsupervised representation and scANVI only when reviewed labels are suitable for semi-supervision and holdout testing.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Do not use scANVI as an annotation oracle or force unknown cells into known classes.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose a conservative architecture and count likelihood before outcomes are inspected.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Repeat justified neighboring architectures and block unstable biological conclusions.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use sample-aware diagnostics and stratified label holdout with enough training and evaluation cells per class.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Report failed convergence, class collapse, and weak held-out performance rather than extending training until a desired result appears.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Emit confidence-bearing suggestions while preserving original unknown labels for separate review.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: No unknown cell is promoted automatically by this module.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Request Bayesian differential expression only for a declared model metadata contrast after model admission; freeze group values, change-mode delta, and result bound before examining outcomes.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Reject absent or ambiguous groups, literal rest categories, missing change-mode fields, and any conversion of cell-level output into donor-level condition evidence.

postflight_checks: Inspect learning histories, finite latent values, batch mixing, reviewed-label purity, label connectivity, and held-out scANVI metrics.
Reconcile cells, features, raw counts, reviewed labels, unknown labels, suggestions, confidences, and review flags.
Reload model and h5ad independently and verify digests, versions, parameters, graph, UMAP, quality state, and downstream representation contract.
Compare against no model and classical integration when the project requires method selection.

For requested Bayesian differential expression, retain contrast parameters, full result location, required change-mode fields, top-feature accounting, and explicit exploratory cell-level interpretation boundary.
preflight_checks: Inspect raw-count, sample, batch, reviewed-label, unknown-label, feature, condition, and source-object semantics.
Detect scvi-tools, Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, torch, Lightning, and Python versions in the existing scientific environment.
Verify sample-to-batch mapping, cross-batch class support, unknown-cell presence, class counts, source immutability, and new output paths.
Freeze mode, architecture, likelihood, train split, holdout fraction, epochs, thresholds, seed, and reload checks before training.

When Bayesian differential expression is requested, verify the group key and both declared categories in the model metadata, a predeclared change-mode delta, result bound, and separate donor-aware inference plan.

version_differences.required_action: Inspect detected signatures, preserve the registered count layer, and reload model and h5ad before admitting results.
Record the actual version and reload all representation and graph keys.

limitations: Threshold flags are descriptive and must be adapted to assay chemistry, tissue, depth, and expected biology.

input.design_notes: Reference labels are independently reviewed; query clusters were generated without reference-label leakage.
input.objective: Map query cells to a reviewed reference and retain unsupported populations as unknown.

code_plan.purpose: Establish whether the query, reference, markers, and ontology are semantically compatible before mapping.
required_logic: Inspect real h5ad count locations, cells, genes, group keys, existing labels, reference labels, feature namespaces, annotation releases, and provenance.
Validate exact gene overlap and reject guessed identifier conversion, duplicated features, missing labels, incomplete marker contracts, and undeclared ontology edges.
Declare thresholds and optional post hoc evaluation labels before viewing mapping outcomes.

code_plan.purpose: Run SingleR on aligned sparse log-normalized expression without modifying source objects.
required_logic: Adapt the template to the observed query and reference structures and exchange genes-by-cells sparse matrices through a temporary workspace.
Run the detected SingleR API and retain forced labels, pruned labels, delta.next, maximum score, and per-label scores in exact query-cell order.
Treat SingleR labels as candidates rather than final annotations.

code_plan.purpose: Accept only reference labels supported by independent biological and ontology constraints.
required_logic: Compute group consensus from forced and pruned SingleR labels and evaluate declared positive and negative markers against the query-wide background.
Resolve candidate ontology identifiers through the declared parent graph and enforce group-level allowed ancestors.
Require cell-level pruning and delta thresholds after group acceptance; retain every conflict, low-confidence cell, or unsupported population as unknown with reason codes.

code_plan.purpose: Bind annotations to a reloadable h5ad and optional independent evaluation.
required_logic: Write candidate, pruned, delta, ontology, conservative label, status, and reason fields to a new h5ad without changing existing labels or raw counts.
Reload and reconcile cells, genes, source labels, counts, annotation fields, contracts, versions, thresholds, and digests.
If independent truth exists, calculate post hoc performance only after decisions are frozen; admit only observed annotations passing all source-preservation gates.

forbidden_actions: Use only already available, project-approved scientific runtimes; do not change the user's execution environment from this module.
Do not guess gene identifier mappings, ontology edges, reference scope, marker evidence, missing labels, or annotation releases.
Do not use existing labels, evaluation truth, expected markers, desired cell types, conditions, or conclusions to tune SingleR or thresholds.
Do not accept a maximum reference score without pruning, group consensus, marker support, ontology allowance, and cell-level confidence.
Do not overwrite raw counts, source h5ad objects, existing labels, unknown labels, cells, genes, or sample provenance.
Do not force transitional, novel, discordant, or unsupported populations into the nearest known reference class.
Do not report generated code, temporary matrix exchange, or an unreloaded h5ad as validated annotation evidence.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use a biologically matched, independently reviewed reference whose scope and missing populations are explicitly documented.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: An unmatched or uncertified atlas remains unavailable rather than silently substituted.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare both an absolute and query-relative overlap requirement before mapping.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Block guessed identifier conversion and references missing required marker genes.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Require independent cell-level and group-level agreement rather than one maximum score.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Retain pruned, discordant, or low-delta cells as unknown.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Predeclare minimum positive support, maximum negative conflict, and allowed ontology ancestors.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Any marker or ontology conflict blocks acceptance regardless of SingleR score.

postflight_checks: Reconcile every SingleR score and label to query-cell order and declared reference classes.
Inspect group consensus, positive marker support, negative conflicts, ontology ancestors, cell pruning, delta thresholds, accepted labels, unknowns, and reason codes.
Reload the annotated h5ad and verify all source cells, genes, existing labels, raw counts, annotations, contracts, tool versions, thresholds, and digests.
Compare optional independent truth only after annotation decisions are frozen and report unsupported reference populations explicitly.
preflight_checks: Inspect query, reference, marker, ontology, feature, label, group, unknown, and optional evaluation semantics from the real artifacts.
Detect SingleR, Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, R, Matrix, BiocParallel, and jsonlite versions in existing environments.
Verify unique identifiers, integer-like counts, exact label-contract coverage, ontology graph fields, query-reference overlap, source immutability, and new output paths.
Freeze normalization, SingleR API, thresholds, reference scope, marker evidence, ontology release, and post hoc evaluation policy before execution.

version_differences.required_action: Use the detected API, preserve exact cell order, parse all returned fields, and independently apply marker and ontology gates.
Reload the output and reconcile every source and annotation field before admission.

input.design_notes: Four independent samples span the process; experimental time is withheld from fitting.
input.objective: Infer RNA velocity and validate direction against independent time and root-terminal evidence.

code_plan.purpose: Establish whether velocity and directional trajectory inference are identifiable.
required_logic: Inspect real spliced and unspliced layers, quantification provenance, cells, genes, samples, time, root and terminal evidence, batches, cell states, and source digest.
Block missing or non-count layers, one-sample designs, ambiguous anchors, inadequate temporal coverage, and guessed direction.
Freeze preprocessing, model, genes, neighbors, anchors, direction thresholds, confidence thresholds, and outputs before execution.

code_plan.purpose: Execute the detected scVelo dynamical API without modifying source counts.
required_logic: Normalize working copies, select HVGs, compute PCA, neighbors, moments, dynamics, velocity, graph, UMAP vectors, velocity pseudotime, latent time, and confidence using version-correct calls.
Keep experimental time out of model fitting and use only declared root and terminal scores for orientation.
Retain failed fit genes and warnings rather than selecting genes from desired temporal behavior.

code_plan.purpose: Test whether the inferred direction is independently supported.
required_logic: Compute Spearman correlations of latent time and velocity pseudotime with withheld experimental time.
Require root cells to precede terminal cells and median velocity confidence to pass predeclared thresholds.
Block temporal interpretation when any direction or confidence gate fails even if the embedding arrows appear coherent.

code_plan.purpose: Write derived trajectory fields to a new full-feature h5ad and verify source preservation.
required_logic: Merge velocity layers, graph, UMAP vectors, pseudotimes, confidence, fit fields, parameters, and quality status into a copy of the full source object.
Reload cells, genes, spliced and unspliced counts, sample and anchor fields, trajectory fields, graph, versions, thresholds, and digest.
Admit only observed direction-validated outputs and keep blocked runs as non-evidentiary model history.

forbidden_actions: Use only already available, project-approved scientific runtimes; do not change the user's execution environment from this module.
Do not fabricate, infer, or silently convert spliced and unspliced counts from total expression.
Do not use experimental time, desired lineage, annotations, markers, conditions, or conclusions to select genes or tune the model.
Do not infer direction from UMAP layout, arrows, root choice alone, or one pseudotime correlation.
Do not overwrite source layers, h5ad objects, cells, genes, samples, anchors, or provenance.
Do not treat cells as condition-level replicates or velocity as proof of lineage causality.
Do not report generated code, an unreloaded object, or a blocked direction as validated trajectory evidence.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare minimum HVG, finite-fit, and velocity-gene counts before model results.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Do not cherry-pick genes by agreement with desired direction.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Choose a stable local neighborhood before velocity graph construction.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Repeat justified neighboring values and block unstable direction.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Predeclare temporal correlations and normalized root-terminal separation required for direction.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Withhold experimental time from fitting and block direction when independent checks fail.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Declare a confidence floor separately from temporal direction.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: An attractive UMAP vector field cannot substitute for confidence or time validation.

postflight_checks: Inspect modeled genes, finite fits, velocity layers, graph, pseudotime, latent time, confidence, and warnings.
Recompute time correlations and root-terminal separation independently from fields withheld during fitting.
Reconcile all source cells, genes, samples, anchors, spliced and unspliced counts, derived fields, parameters, versions, and digests after reload.
Keep cell-level trajectory interpretation separate from donor-level condition inference and from causal lineage claims.
preflight_checks: Inspect real spliced/unspliced counts, quantification provenance, sample design, time, roots, terminals, batches, states, feature namespace, and source object.
Detect scVelo, Scanpy, AnnData, NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, Numba, UMAP, and Python versions in the existing scientific environment.
Verify unique identifiers, layer alignment, integer-like counts, multiple samples, time coverage, nonoverlapping anchors, source immutability, and new output paths.
Freeze normalization, HVG, PCA, neighbors, dynamics iterations, seed, direction and confidence thresholds, and reload checks.

version_differences.required_action: Call normalization, log transform, HVG selection, PCA, neighbors, moments, dynamics, and direction methods separately and reload all fields.
Record parameters and reload representation, graph, and output fields.

result_statements.text: The estimated mean difference was reported with a 95% CI.

limitations: This audit checks declared design and reporting records; it does not reanalyse raw data or establish that a selected model is scientifically correct.
A domain statistician or study-design expert must review analyses whose design, dependence structure, missingness, or estimand remains ambiguous.

output.method: Kaplan-Meier product-limit estimate with Greenwood standard error

issues.rationale: The cited source was not effective during the asserted event interval.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the version effective during the event or revise the governance claim.

limitations: The module evaluates supplied structured bindings and does not infer every temporal relation from unrestricted prose.
Timeline completeness and provenance declarations still require project governance and primary-evidence review.
quality_gates: Publication date never substitutes for a source's effective date range.
Low-confidence or missing temporal facts remain unresolved and are never used as arithmetic ground truth.
Causal direction requires nonoverlapping verified intervals in the asserted order.
A missing comparator is called phantom only when the version catalog is explicitly exhaustive.
The reference date is supplied and recorded; wall-clock time never changes the audit result.

output.method: eligible somatic variants divided by declared callable megabases
quality_gates: Use an assay- and indication-specific validated definition of variant classes and callable territory.
Document genome build, germline filtering, sequencing depth, purity, and limit of detection.
This descriptive value is not a clinical high/low classification or treatment recommendation.
